messages.author: a27dbaf416dd51de
messages.subject: Renjin Package - CBPS 0.7
parts:
Hello Renjin Devs!

I'm working on a project that requires the use of a specific R library that we're hoping to get running on Renjin, but the package build results at http://packages.renjin.org/packages/CBPS.html for the package are for the previous release of the library. I took a look at the change log and it seems like the function that's missing should be available in the CBPS 0.7 package. 

Can I assist in getting this dependency updated so we can make use of it? Admittedly I'm not all that familiar with R, but it seems like all this would take is an update to the newest version. I tried to find the git repository producing that build output but the closest repo I found hasn't been updated for 6 months (https://github.com/bedatadriven/renjin-cran-builds). 

If you could point me to the right repository I might be able to get this done myself (and happily contribute it back :).

Thanks in advance,

Casey

messages.author: f06db63329fab1f9
messages.subject: Re: Renjin Package - CBPS 0.7
parts:
Hi Casey!
packages.renjin.org is actually produced by :
https://github.com/bedatadriven/renjin-cran-tests

(I've removed the old repo which we're no longer using)

The cran harness should be downloading and building the latest version automatically from CRAN- I will check why this isn't happening, and see if we can another build up this week.

Best,
Alex
